title: Route features/account/* imports of onboarding validators/screens through the onboarding barrel, not deep paths

evidence.quote: // Import this barrel (features/onboarding/onboarding.dart) from outside this

why: features/onboarding/onboarding.dart is the designated public surface ('Do NOT import deep paths directly') but it is an 8-line stub with zero export statements. Two account-feature screens (both audit HOTSPOT files) have no compliant way to reach auth_validators.dart and instead reach 2-3 directories deep into another feature's domain/ internals. A repo-wide grep shows this same pattern recurring ~26 times across 15 other files reaching into features/onboarding/, so this batch's file is one instance of a feature with an effectively non-functional barrel.
recommendation: Populate features/onboarding/onboarding.dart with real exports (at minimum auth_validators.dart's public surface and whatever of onboarding_screen.dart is legitimately consumed cross-feature) and repoint the 2 importers at the barrel.
acceptance_criteria: Once the check-15/15 fix (paired finding) is in place, `make audit` reports zero cross-feature deep imports into lib/features/onboarding/ from signup_screen.dart and sign_in_screen.dart

corrections: coding-standards.md Rule 2 prose literally says the sanctioned barrel is lib/features/Y/providers.dart, not Y.dart — no providers.dart file exists anywhere in the repo, while all 15 features use the <feature>.dart pattern (matching the Makefile check-15 regex's own \1.dart backreference). The finding's identification of onboarding.dart as the intended barrel is corroborated by actual repo convention/tooling, not by the literal doc text; treat as a doc-drift caveat, not a defect in this finding.
